description: Create, change or remove map events; the map file is written immediately. action "create" without `preset` makes a bare event at x/y (empty page unless `pages`; then use add_command or insert_event_commands). With `preset` it builds a ready event: "npc" {name, dialogues[], characterName?, characterIndex?}; "chest" one-time loot {items: [{type item|weapon|armor, id, amount}]}; "teleport" walk-on transfer {destMapId, destX, destY, trigger?}; "door" action-button warp {destMapId, destX, destY, characterName?, characterIndex?, trigger?, lockedSwitchId?, lockedMessage?}, locked until that switch is ON; "shop" {goods: [[type 0 item/1 weapon/2 armor, id, priceType 0 standard/1 custom, price]]}; "inn" {cost?}; "boss" {troopId} one-time battle, game over on loss; "puzzle_switch" {switchX, switchY, doorX, doorY, gameSwitchId, switchName?, doorName?} makes two linked events. A missing destination map, troop, item or switch is refused; an unwalkable or occupied tile is created anyway and listed in `warnings`. "update" overwrites only `fields`. "convert" keeps an event's id, position, name and sprite but replaces its behaviour via `kind`: "merchant" (options.goods, or options.items [{type, id}], options.greeting?), "inn" (options.cost?), "sign" (options.text). "delete" removes it (destructive). "add_command" appends one command before a page's end. "populate" scatters N npc/chest/boss events on random free tiles of the main walkable area of the map (explicit opts.x/opts.y are used as given). Returns the event(s) with ids; fails if the map or event does not exist.

action.description: What to do; see the tool description. Default "create"

characterIndex.description: Which of the 8 characters in the sheet (0-7)

characterName.description: Sprite sheet from img/characters/ without extension; list options with get_project_context

command.description: action "add_command": event command {code, indent, parameters}; e.g. 201=Transfer Player [0, mapId, x, y, dir, fade]

cost.description: preset "inn": gold charged for a full recovery (default 50)

destX.description: preset "teleport"/"door": destination tile X (should be walkable)

dialogues.description: preset "npc": dialogue lines, each becomes one text box

doorName.description: preset "puzzle_switch": editor name for the door event (default "Door")

eventId.description: Existing event ID (update/delete/add_command); find it with query_map view "events"

eventType.description: action "populate": kind of events to scatter — "npc", "chest" or "boss"

fields.description: action "update": properties to overwrite, e.g. {"x": 5, "y": 9} or {"pages": [...]} (replaces all pages)

gameSwitchId.description: preset "puzzle_switch": game switch linking switch and door — pick an unused ID via manage_system get switches

goods.description: preset "shop": wares [[type, id, priceType, price]] — priceType 1 uses the custom price, 0 the database price

kind.description: action "convert": what to turn the existing event into

lockedMessage.description: preset "door": message shown while locked (default "It's locked.")

lockedSwitchId.description: preset "door": if set, the door shows lockedMessage until this game switch is ON, then warps

mapId.description: Map the event lives on (always required)

name.description: Event name shown in the editor

options.description: action "convert": kind-specific settings — merchant {goods|items, greeting?}, inn {cost?}, sign {text}

pageIndex.description: action "add_command": which page receives the command (0-based, default 0)

pages.description: action "create" without preset: full event page objects (optional)

preset.description: action "create" only: ready-made event recipe; omit for a low-level empty event

switchName.description: preset "puzzle_switch": editor name for the switch event (default "Switch")

trigger.description: How the event activates: 0=action button, 1=player touch, 2=event touch, 3=autorun, 4=parallel

troopId.description: preset "boss" / populate boss: troop to battle (create it first via create_database_entry preset encounter_troop)

x.description: Tile X position (0-based; create/presets except puzzle_switch)

name: manage_map_event
